purpose: Clean-baseline starting hyperparameters for Fed-ISIC2019 runs before the full experiment0 tuning sweep is executed.

selection_notes.metric: Primary tuning metric is server balanced accuracy; validation loss is the tie-breaker.
selection_notes.future_main_experiment_trials: Use 3 trials by default after hyperparameters are selected; consider 5 only if compute budget allows.
selection_notes.client_participation: Full participation over the six natural Fed-ISIC2019 centers.
selection_notes.communication: No drops, no noise, no compression.
selection_notes.source_values: FLamby-style values are used where available; otherwise FEMNIST selected values seed the first Fed-ISIC2019 search.
selection_notes.fednova_variant_selection: Experiment 0 tries momentum only, server momentum only, prox only, both momentums, and both momentums plus prox; keep the best-performing variant.
selection_notes.fedlt_variant_selection: Experiment 0 tries local solvers gd, nesterov, and adam; keep the best-performing solver.
selection_notes.fedopt_family_selection: Experiment 0 tries FedAdam, FedYogi, and FedAdagrad; keep the best-performing FedOpt family member.
